name: Mistral 3.1

weak.d: 8k words for frontier-capable model remains sparse by 2025 standards.

blurb: Latest Mistral. 8k words of documentation at a point where Anthropic is publishing 200k+. The growing disclosure gap between European and American frontier labs is one of the set's central findings.
